summary: # Milestone Workflow Rules (Claude ↔ Codex ↔ ChatGPT) Standing rules for VEGO-AI human–AI co-reasoning milestone work. Set after M1/M2/M3 landed on `main` without reviewable PRs because automation fast-forwarded `main`. ## Roles - **Claude** — primary feature/milestone implementation agent. - **Codex** — infrastructure, review, documentation, and gap-filling agent. - **ChatGPT** — research orchestrator and architecture reviewer (approves merges to `main`). ## Branch / PR discipline - Milestone C
